name.description: The application name. Required unless --document is given; defaults to the dasherized Application node id.

routing.description: Enable routing. Defaults to true. Not allowed with --document (routing follows the Application node's Routing child).

ssr.description: Configure the application for Server-Side Rendering (SSR) and Static Site Generation (SSG/Prerendering). Defaults to false.

zoneless.description: Generate an application that does not use zone.js. Defaults to true.

style.description: The stylesheet format. Defaults to scss.

document.description: Workspace-relative path to a canonical OpenUI JSON document (*.openui.json or *.json). Compiles an Application node: the name defaults to its dasherized id and routing is enabled when it has a Routing child.

nodeId.description: Optional element ID of the Application node. When omitted, targets the first Application element. Requires --document.
